svg.title: gradientTransform on a non-square bounding box
svg.desc: Regression fixture: every resvg-sourced gradientTransform fixture uses a 160x160 (square) bbox, under which composing bboxM.Mul(gradM) instead of gradM.Mul(bboxM) differs only by a small translation and is hard to see. This 200x50 wide rect makes the two orders diverge in ANGLE, not just position: rotate(30) must appear to rotate the gradient axis about the gradient's own local origin, THEN map into the rect's bounding box -- not rotate about the user-space origin after the bbox mapping has already sheared local space non-uniformly.
